baseline.artifact: data/v3/v3_1d/final_model_arm_b.joblib (accepted V3.1 artifact/spec; no retraining vs 2025)

calibration_protocol: RAW primary; sigmoid/isotonic challengers fit on inner-train history only; selection requires beating RAW beyond 1e-4 without worsening Brier; D outcome: RAW retained for XGB
development_protocol: outer folds D1/D2/D3 (validate 2022/2023/2024); inner tuning inside outer TRAIN only; outer validation never selects hyperparameters; small preregistered grids (<=12/family); primary metric race-macro LL; paired race bootstrap seed 42 B=2000
holdout_protocol: one-shot 2025 AFTER frozen D recipe + E manifest; single fit/predict per recipe; no_retry attested; HOLDOUT_REVEALED=TRUE
known_limitations: only one challenger reached final holdout
XGB diversity evidence modest, not proof ensemble will improve
HGB/ET not evaluated on 2025 by design
row-order analysis incident corrected from immutable predictions

row_order_incident.cause: baseline/XGB sets matched but row order differed during analysis

scientific_question: Can any admitted non-logistic family beat the frozen V3.1B logistic champion on out-of-time race-macro log loss, and does any non-winner merit V3.4 ensemble research as a diversity candidate?

test_evidence.tier1: full pytest tests/ green (see freeze record)

transfer_development_vs_holdout.interpretation: XGB failed to establish standalone superiority; out-of-time behavior broadly consistent with development; CI-spans-zero is not proof of equality
